name: Scavenger

description.content: While holding an empty Toolbox, whenever you hit a great Skill Check while repairing, earn [1] Token.
When you have [5] Tokens, spend them all:
You can rummage Chests [1] time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Toolbox.

quote: "It's amazing what people will throw away around here." -Gabriel Soma
